description: A comprehensive .NET client library for ConnectWise Manage REST API v3.0. Features strongly-typed entities, automatic pagination with GetAllAsync, advanced filtering, built-in caching, and complete CRUD operations for all major ConnectWise Manage modules including Service Desk, Company Management, Finance, Time and Expense, and more.
releaseNotes:
3.1.0 - BREAKING: Company.CustomFieldValue.Value is now typed object rather than string. Recompilation is required, and code that assigned it directly to a string will need updating. This affects Company, Configuration, Agreement and Project, which share the type.

			The reason is that ConnectWise returns customFields[].value polymorphically, keyed off the sibling "type" discriminator: a string for Text, a number for Number, a boolean for Checkbox, an ISO date for Date, and null when unset. Typing it as string meant any record carrying a non-text custom field threw "The JSON value could not be converted to System.String" and the entire request failed, so those four entities were unreadable for a large share of real tenants. Values now resolve to CLR scalars (string, long, double, bool, DateTime), never JsonElement. Common.CustomField.Value, used by Ticket, Contact and Activity, has behaved this way since 3.0.53 and is unchanged.

			Note the minor rather than major bump: the major version tracks the ConnectWise Manage REST API generation, which is still v3, so 4.0.0 would misrepresent it.

			Also adds 83 offline unit tests covering ObjectToInferredTypesConverter and custom field deserialisation, neither of which previously had coverage that could run without live credentials, and publishing is now gated on them.

			3.0.74 - README packaged with the NuGet package.

			3.0.72 - Central Package Management and shared build properties. NuGet governance fixes.

			3.0.70 - Added ConnectWiseClient.ClearCache(). PATCH fixes.

			3.0.68 - Reference types are now nullable across the model classes. Consumers compiling with nullable reference types enabled may see new warnings.

			3.0.64 - Added DefaultPageSize to ConnectWiseClientOptions.

			3.0.62 - Custom field and question answers now deserialise to primitive CLR types rather than JsonElement.

			3.0.59 - Added a configurable HTTP timeout and LicenseBit support.

			3.0.58 - Unmapped JSON members are now rejected in DEBUG builds only, to surface model gaps during development without affecting release behaviour.

			3.0.53 - BREAKING: migrated from Newtonsoft.Json to System.Text.Json throughout. Custom JsonConverter implementations registered against Newtonsoft will no longer apply. Numerous model corrections.

			3.0.48 - Sub-resource endpoints can now be queried by supplying path parameters, so board-scoped collections such as statuses, types, subtypes and teams are reachable.

			3.0.43 - ConnectWiseClientOptions now requires an ILogger. Request and response logging added at Trace level.

			3.0.40 - BREAKING: ConnectWiseClient now takes a ConnectWiseClientOptions. The individual-argument constructors still work but are marked obsolete and will be removed in a future major version.

			3.0.35 - Major update: Added GetAllAsync method for automatic pagination across all pages. Fixed BillingCycle.BillingOptions model (changed from Reference to string). Enhanced test infrastructure with emoji indicators and permission-aware testing. Improved test coverage to 88% (241/274 tests passing). Performance improvements - tests now run 43% faster (5m 30s vs 9m 38s).

			3.0.34 - Published GetAllAsync feature with comprehensive testing (tested with 21,577 configurations). Enhanced README with extensive query examples.

			3.0.28 - Stability improvements and bug fixes

			3.0.20 - Currency entity now has CurrencyCode rather than the (incorrect) IsoCode. Added other missing members to CurrencyCode

			3.0.19 - Improved BaseAddress getter on ConnectWiseClient, to ensure HTTP client base address avoids protocol duplication, i.e. no https://https

			3.0.2 - Alignment with V3 of the ConnectWise Manage API.  Breaking changes.

			1.0.5 - Made Ticket.ClosedDate nullable

			1.0.4 - Client Get Cacheing, Added Site and PoNumber to Ticket

			1.0.3 - Fixes to Ticket class

			1.0.2 - Query parameter support

			1.0.1 - Additional properties after testing against a real-world system

			1.0.0 - Supports simple GetPage, GetById and GetSingleton methods for all endpoints referenced here: https://developer.connectwise.com/Manage/REST.
